argv:
set -eu
cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id; cat /proc/uptime
find /sys/class/typec -maxdepth 2 -type l -print
for f in /sys/class/typec/port0-partner/supports_usb_power_delivery /sys/class/typec/port0-partner/usb_power_delivery_revision; do
    if test -r "$f"; then printf '%s=' "$f"; cat "$f"; fi
done
if test -d /sys/class/usb_power_delivery; then ls -lR /sys/class/usb_power_delivery; else echo usb_power_delivery-class-unavailable; fi
